```{r}
#| message: false
here::i_am("dplyr-101.Rproj")
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(vroom)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
account <- vroom(here("Financial", "account.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    account_id = col_integer(),
    district_id = col_integer(),
    frequency = col_character(),
    date = col_date(format = ""),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
client <- vroom("Financial/client.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    client_id = col_integer(),
    gender = col_factor(levels = c("F", "M")),
    birth_date = col_date(format = ""),
    district_id = col_integer(),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
disp <- vroom(here("Financial", "disp.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    disp_id = col_integer(),
    client_id = col_integer(),
    account_id = col_integer(),
    type = col_factor(levels = c("OWNER", "DISPONENT")),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
district <- vroom(here("Financial","district.csv"),
                  col_types = cols(
  district_id = col_integer(),
  A2 = col_character(),
  A3 = col_character(),
  A4 = col_double(),
  A5 = col_double(),
  A6 = col_double(),
  A7 = col_double(),
  A8 = col_double(),
  A9 = col_double(),
  A10 = col_double(),
  A11 = col_double(),
  A12 = col_double(),
  A13 = col_double(),
  A14 = col_double(),
  A15 = col_double(),
  A16 = col_double(),
  .delim = ","
))
```

```{r}
account |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 30)
```

## Joining two tables

### Inner join

```{r}
dc <- inner_join(disp, client, by = join_by(client_id))
```


```{r}
dc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gender, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill")
```


```{r}
dc |>
  summarise(n=n(), .by=c(gender, type)) |>
  mutate(freq = n/sum(n), .by = gender) |>
  select(!n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = freq)
```
```{r}
set.seed(0)
B <- data.frame(
  b_id = 1:6,
  Y = sample(1:3, size = 6, replace =TRUE),
  Z = sample(letters, size = 6)
)
A <- data.frame(
  a_id = 1:4,
  X = seq(0, 1, length.out = 4),
  b_id = B |> slice_sample(n = 4, replace = TRUE) |> pull(b_id)
)
```


```{r}
inner_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id))
```

```{r}
inner_join(B, A, by = join_by(b_id))
```


```{r}
inner_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```

```{r}
inner_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id < Y))
```
### Outer joins

```{r}
left_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```

```{r}
right_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```

```{r}
full_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id == Y))
```

## More than two tables

```{r}
client_account <- inner_join(client, disp, by = join_by(client_id)) |> 
  inner_join(account, by = join_by(account_id), suffix = c("_client", "_account"))
```

```{r}
client_account |>
  mutate(bank_at_home = district_id_client == district_id_account) |>
  summarise(n(), .by=bank_at_home)
```
```{r}
client_moved <- client_account |>
  filter(district_id_client != district_id_account)
```

```{r}
d_urban <- district |>
  select(district_id, A10) |>
  rename(urban_fraction = A10)
client_district <- inner_join(client_moved, d_urban, join_by(district_id_client == district_id)) |>
  rename(uf_client = urban_fraction) |>
  inner_join(d_urban, join_by(district_id_account == district_id)) |>
  rename(uf_account = urban_fraction)
```

```{r}
client_district |>
  filter(type=="OWNER") |>
  select(client_id, uf_client, uf_account) |>
  pivot_longer(!client_id, names_to = "Location", values_to = "Urban Fraction") |>
  ggplot(aes(x=`Urban Fraction`, fill = Location)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.2) +
    geom_rug()
```
## Anti and Semi join
```{r}
A
B
```

```{r}
anti_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id))
```

```{r}
anti_join(B, A, by = join_by(b_id))
```

```{r}
semi_join(A, B, by = join_by(b_id))
```

```{r}
semi_join(B, A, by = join_by(b_id))
```
